source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Keep home oxygen away from smoking, flames, sparks, and heat sources because an oxygen-enriched environment makes combustible materials ignite and burn more readily.","B":"Permit smoking after the cannula is removed for several minutes because oxygen no longer contributes to fire risk once the device is off the face.","C":"Place the oxygen concentrator near the cooking area so the client can monitor it while using a gas stove or other open-flame appliance.","D":"Use petroleum-based products around oxygen tubing because they decrease friction and therefore lower the chance of ignition near the equipment."}}
source_row.rationale: Oxygen supports combustion and increases fire intensity. Home oxygen safety guidance requires avoiding smoking, open flames, sparks and heat sources.
